Descriptions.ShortDescription: Records imaging sessions and delivers detailed HTML reports with yield analysis, live stack thumbnails, metric charts, and more via email, Discord, or Pushover.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Night Summary automatically records your astrophotography session as it runs and delivers a rich HTML report the moment your sequence completes. Reports include session overview stats, equipment profile, event timeline, yield and imaging overhead analysis with per-category breakdown, per-target summaries with altitude charts and sky thumbnails, Live Stack integration, image quality metrics (HFR, FWHM, Eccentricity, guiding RMS, Median ADU), Target Scheduler integration with progress bars and Tonight's Preview, configurable metric charts with event markers, and session history. Supports email (any SMTP provider), Discord webhooks, Pushover, and local save with NINA filename pattern variables.
